subject: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood deployment at Octave Health
messages:
From: Matthew Hopkins <matthew.hopkins@octavehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@octavehealth.com>, eng-team@octavehealth.com
Date: 2026-03-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood deployment at Octave Health

Hi Jonas/Camila —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The engineering leadership at Octave wants a focused architecture deep-dive to validate the deployment pattern and discuss networking and audit/log delivery for our compliance team. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue Mar 10, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 11, 14:00–15:00

We prefer Zoom but can do Google Meet if that is easier for your side. We will have 6 people from our infra group + our CISO (Olivia) for the first 45 minutes. Can you share a calendar invite with dial-in + presenting instructions? Also, please attach any network diagram or diagram of the dedicated/private flow you plan to show.

Thanks,
Matt
Director of Infrastructure
Octave Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Hopkins <matthew.hopkins@octavehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood deployment at Octave Health

Matt —

Appreciate the invite. We can do either slot but suggest Tue Mar 10, 10:00–11:00 PST so we can get the CISO time early in the week. We'll plan to cover: network topology, private VPC patterns, audit logs/KMS integration, and a short live walkthrough of the console + ops tooling.

Attaching the network diagram and a short 6-slide overview (redwood-arch-overview-v2.pdf, octave-network-diagram.png). Proposed presenters: Camila (network + private), Laura (audit/KMS), Ava (console walkthrough).

Zoom is fine — I'll create the meeting and send calendar invite once Matt confirms. Note: if you need dial-in numbers for other regions, say the word and we'll include them.

Cheers,
Jonas
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood-arch-overview-v2.pdf (application/pdf), octave-network-diagram.png (image/png)

Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood deployment at Octave Health

Jonas —

Quick note: Tue morning is problematic for two of our senior infra folks due to a standing calendar conflict in our main conference room (Conf West 2). They'd prefer Wed Mar 11, 14:00–15:00 if that works. Also, our facilities team reports intermittent AV problems with Conf West 2 (mics drop). If you must keep the Tue slot, we can arrange for our team to dial in from laptops and use a secondary room, but preference is to move to Wed.

If we switch to Wed, could you send a Google Meet instead of Zoom? Our org-wide security policy has a short permit for Meet that reduces friction for our internal users.

Thanks,
Olivia
CISO, Octave Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood deployment at Octave Health

Olivia / Matt —

Thanks for the heads up — Wed Mar 11, 14:00–15:00 PST works for our team as well. No issue switching to Google Meet; we'll include a Meet link in the calendar invite and also include a Zoom fallback link in case any external participants prefer it.

One operational ask: Conf West 2 AV issues are noted. Can someone from Octave confirm whether the room will have an HDMI cable and a nearby power outlet for a presenter laptop? If not, we'll bring a spare USB-C HDMI adapter and recommend everyone keep their cameras on for the first 10 minutes while we sort audio levels.

I'll schedule the event and include presenters + the deck. Jonas, Laura, Ava — any additional prep items?

—Camila
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Confirmed: Wed Mar 11, 14:00–15:00 PST. I've created the calendar event (Google Meet primary + Zoom fallback). Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-redwood-octave (add to your calendars). Meet link (primary): https://meet.google.com/rnd-arch-345
Zoom fallback: https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=meetingPwd
Dial-in (US): +1 415-555-0132 (PIN 2468) — I'll add international numbers in the event description.

Agenda (45m core + 15m open Q&A):
- 0–5m Introductions and goals (Jonas)
- 5–25m Network/vpc/private deployment patterns (Camila)
- 25–40m Audit/KMS/retention (Laura)
- 40–55m Console walkthrough + ops notes (Ava)
- 55–60m Next steps and actions

Presenter checklist:
- Bring laptop + USB-C HDMI adapter (Camila will bring a spare)
- Test camera/audio 10 minutes before start
- Share the attached deck from the calendar event for reference

Facilities — tagging facilities@octavehealth.com: can you confirm HDMI + power availability in Conf West 2 and whether an AV tech can be on standby at 13:50 PST? If AV is unreliable, we'll ask the room attendees to dial in individually and use the Meet link.

Attachments included on the event: redwood-arch-overview-v2.pdf, octave-network-diagram.png

Looking forward to the session.

Best,
